path.description: Existing task-relative file, not a URL. Source files stay unchanged.

valid_mask_path.description: Optional aligned one-band mask: valid finite values >0 are included. Supply QA-derived clear pixels; no cloud detection is guessed.

breaks.description: Strictly increasing display/statistical class edges. Default [0,0.2,0.5]; intervals are NOT land-cover labels.

analysis_type.description: Analysis family identifying the scientific processing method, not a geological classification.

manifest_path.description: Task-relative analysis.geoanalysis.json containing input/output hashes, parameters, grid, layers, statistics and limitations.

outputs.description: Actual generated files with task-relative paths, SHA-256 hashes, MIME types and scientific/display roles.

statistics.description: Actual computed statistics; null means unavailable, never zero.

warnings.description: Scientific and data-quality limitations that must accompany interpretation; not evidence of successful independent scientific certification.
